title: Iridescent foil sheen on a still mark
summary: A single brand mark holds dead centre on black while a pearly, iridescent foil sheen drifts across its surface. Nothing moves but the light, so the mark reads as a premium physical object.
use_when: A premium end card or logo sting of about 3 s
A brand with a bold, solid mark that can carry a surface texture
Silent loops for social headers or product pages
Closing a longer film where the mark should feel tangible, not animated

look.type_style: no type; one solid mark about 60 % of frame width, 40 % of frame height, centred slightly above middle

sfx.event: foil sheen band crosses the mark

structure.shot: one solid brand mark centred on pure black, its fill a pearly silver foil with lilac, mint and blue tints
structure.camera: static: mark position and width identical in all 12 cells (±1 px on the sheet); motion.json zoom 0.8-1.9 %/s is the sheen flow, not geometry
structure.motion: only the fill moves: soft highlight bands drift along the mark, easings.linear over the whole 89 fr (±0.25 s); fill brightens to near white by 2.50-2.77 and a fine dot emboss shows through

params.brand: any brand.json with a solid single-colour mark (vector or alpha image); bg forced to near black
params.content.mark: the mark to foil; a wordmark works if strokes are thick
params.foil.tints: 3-4 pastel tints mixed into the silver base (default lilac, mint, ice blue)
params.foil.speed: sheen drift in mark widths per second (default ~0.3)
params.foil.dots: strength of the fine dot emboss, 0 = off
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; mark scales to 60 % of the shorter fit

notes: One shot, 0 cuts, no audio in the reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. The only motion is the iridescent fill: a silver base with drifting lilac/mint/blue highlight bands; the mark outline has a thin darker grey rim. Brightness rises toward the end (cells 2.50, 2.77 near white) and a fine dot emboss becomes visible (tagged halftone). Proposed term (not in vocabulary): foil-sheen, an animated iridescent gradient clipped to the mark. Missing component FoilMark. Not loopable: last cell is brighter than the first.
